brief:
The pause in Israeli bombing has failed to reverse the humanitarian catastrophe unfolding in Gaza, where Palestinians bearing life-altering injuries struggle to survive amid widespread devastation, Middle East Eye reported. The reduction in airstrikes has not restored basic services or addressed the scale of injuries sustained during the conflict.

Survivors face a landscape stripped of functioning infrastructure, leaving them unable to access adequate medical care or rebuild their lives. Hospitals remain damaged or non-operational, and water and sanitation systems have collapsed. The ceasefire, according to the reporting, represents a temporary reprieve rather than a foundation for recovery or reconstruction.

title: Gaza ceasefire slows but does not halt societal destruction
